NEWS: Tesla wants to build solar panels from scratch in Texas and the plans are massive. A new public filing lays out the whole thing. Tesla is calling it Project Crystal Sun and it would rise on about 3,000 acres in Fort Bend County, just outside Houston. What makes it stand out is that Tesla would do everything in one place. It would start with raw silicon and carry it all the way to finished solar panels, instead of relying on parts shipped in from overseas. The size of the bet is about $10.1 billion. Around $1.5 billion goes to land and buildings and $8.6 billion goes to equipment. Tesla wants to break ground this year, finish in 2028 and start making solar cells in early 2029. Once it is fully running, the plant would employ 9,712 people, with the average job paying around $122,000 a year. At the busiest point of construction, another 1,147 workers would be on site. The effect on Texas is where it gets big. The filing estimates the plant would add about $107 billion to the state's economy, lift local earnings by $68 billion, support more than 13,000 jobs in total and bring in around $6.4 billion in state and local taxes over time. And there is a bigger goal behind it. Back in January, at the World Economic Forum, Elon Musk said the Tesla and SpaceX teams are each working to build up to 100 gigawatts a year of solar power made in America. He figured that would take about three years. This factory is a step toward that. Source: Tesla's Project Crystal Sun filing in Texas, July 2026

A fresh poll: 77% of Ukrainians living in Ukraine believe that while Russia is advancing on the battlefield, it is doing so very slowly and at enormous cost, and Ukraine is still capable of mounting effective resistance. Only 12% believe that further resistance is futile and doomed. 60% consider it completely unacceptable for Ukraine to withdraw its troops from the Donbas at the Kremlin’s demand and hand the region over to Russia in exchange for security guarantees from the U.S. and Europe. 27% say it would be a painful but acceptable decision, while just 5% would readily agree to it. (In other words, very few Ukrainians have any illusions about what would happen if Ukraine surrendered its main defensive lines to Russia, or about how much those “security guarantees” would actually help.) 45% expect the war to end in the second half of 2027 or even later. Another 15% expect it to end in the first half of 2027, and 15% in the autumn or winter of 2026. Only 5% expect the war to end anytime soon, in the summer of 2026. 61% say they are prepared to endure the war for as long as necessary. 20% say they are prepared to endure it for another several months or six months, and 5% for another year. So overall, Ukrainians seem to have very few illusions about this war ending anytime soon.

"In 1964, in Albuquerque, New Mexico, a 17-year-old girl gave birth to a son. The school administrators had told her she couldn't finish high school. She pushed back anyway. Her name was Jacklyn Gise. And the baby she was determined to raise would one day become one of the most influential people on Earth. Being a pregnant teenager in 1960s Albuquerque wasn't just difficult — it was scandalous. When Jacklyn tried to return to school after giving birth, the administration told her no. She didn't accept that answer. ""I pushed back and I kept on pushing back,"" she would later recall. ""Eventually the school relented."" But there were conditions. She couldn't talk to other students. She couldn't eat in the cafeteria. She had to arrive and leave within five minutes of the bells. She agreed to all of it. And she graduated. Her marriage to her son's biological father, Ted Jorgensen, didn't survive. They were both teenagers when they married. He struggled with alcohol. They divorced before Jeff was even two years old. Suddenly, Jacklyn was a single mother with no money. She found work as a secretary, earning $190 a month. It was barely enough to afford rent. She couldn't even pay for a telephone. Her father rigged up a walkie-talkie system so she could check in with her parents every morning at 7 a.m. ""That's how we were able to stay in an apartment,"" she later explained. ""Because I didn't have to pay for a phone."" Determined to continue her education, Jacklyn enrolled in night school. She chose her classes based on which professors would let her bring her infant son to class. She would show up with two duffel bags — one filled with textbooks, the other with cloth diapers, bottles, and toys to keep baby Jeff occupied. It was in one of those night classes that she met a young Cuban refugee named Miguel Bezos. He had arrived in the United States at age 15, fleeing Castro's regime with almost nothing. They fell in love. Mike, as everyone called him, adopted Jeff and gave him his name. Together, Jacklyn and Mike built a home where hard work, education, and big dreams were the foundation of everything. Jacklyn never stopped learning. Even after putting her college dreams on hold to raise her family and support Mike's career, she went back. In her late thirties, she enrolled again. She was relentless. At age 40, Jacklyn Bezos finally earned her college degree. ""When I graduated from the College of Saint Elizabeth at the age of 40,"" she said, ""I had never been more proud of myself."" Then, in 1995, her oldest son came to her and Mike with a proposal that sounded risky. Jeff wanted to quit his stable Wall Street job to start a company selling books on the internet. Most people had barely heard of the internet. Almost no one was shopping on it. He told his parents there was a 70% chance the company would fail. They invested anyway. Jacklyn and Mike put approximately $245,000 into their son's startup. It was an enormous leap of faith. If Jeff was right about the odds, they would lose everything. The company was called Amazon. By 2018, that investment had grown to approximately $30 billion. But the money was never the point for Jacklyn. Jeff Bezos has spoken publicly about his mother countless times. He called her story ""incredible."" He credits her not just for the financial investment, but for the foundation she built — the values she instilled, the example she set, the sacrifices she made when he was too young to understand them. Jacklyn Bezos never sought the spotlight. While her son became one of the most recognizable people on the planet, she worked quietly behind the scenes. She co-founded the Bezos Family Foundation, donating hundreds of millions to education and health causes. She championed opportunities for young people, especially those who faced obstacles like she once did. She passed away in August 2025 at the age of 78, after battling Lewy body dementia. Her son announced her death with a simple tribute: ""She pounced on the job of loving me with ferocity."" Jacklyn Bezos's life proves something important about parenting. The most valuable gift you can give your children isn't money. It's showing them what's possible by refusing to accept what others say is impossible. She was a teenage mother who society might have written off. Instead, she raised a son who changed the world — and she did it by changing hers first."

What @SpaceX is doing with Starlink Mobile is really smart. Instead of building out traditional tall cell towers that would cost billions, SpaceX will deploy small stations that are basically enhanced Starlink dishes on the same mounts and hardware as normal dishes. The spectrum they bought from EchoStar for $19.6B last year includes terrestrial rights, so they can run a hybrid network. Satellites for dead-zone coverage, and low-cost femtocells on existing Starlink sites for better performance in populated areas. Plus, they can deploy these small stations whenever needed. Genius.

All year long we heard “we’ll get to the SAVE America Act when we have time,” realizing it would likely take a few weeks. We waited patiently while fully funding DHS and addressing other priorities, expecting to return to it when time allowed. It’s now August, and we’ve already taken more recess weeks this year than I can count. There are 21 weeks remaining in 2026, and approximately 14 of them will be spent with the Senate in recess. Why? These few weeks in August offer what could be the perfect chance to return to the SAVE America Act and debate the bill until it passes. We should be doing precisely that. Frankly, we should have done it months ago. That’s why I objected to recess and voted against it. Unfortunately, I and those who joined me in opposing it were far outnumbered—with all Democrats and most Republicans preferring to take yet another lengthy recess, this time until September 14th. Lost opportunity.

El acercamiento de la expareja, que en junio pasado sorprendió al público durante un encuentro teatral compartido, marcó un nuevo capítulo en una relación marcada por el paso del tiempo, las heridas y, finalmente, la reconciliación. Pero la escena volvió a tomar protagonismo cuando, en la última emisión del ciclo de Mirtha Legrand, La Noche de Mirtha (El Trece), el propio Suar se refirió al llanto de Araceli en la misma mesa de la diva, ocurrido en diciembre pasado. La conversación se activó cuando Mirtha, siempre atenta a los gestos y las historias personales, fue directo al punto: “¿Te amigaste con Araceli?”, le preguntó a Suar en su característico tono intimista. El gerente de Programación de El Trece no dudó en responder: “Sí, me amigué”. Mirtha, recordando el clima emotivo de aquella noche con González como invitada, agregó: “Ay, pobre, lloró sentada acá, cuando vino…”. Suar, sincero, reconoció: “Sí, lo había visto, pobre Ara. Porque todo el mundo había pensado no sé qué cosa. Yo creo que estaba muy tomada emocionalmente por varias cosas personales que le estaban pasando”. 🔗infob.ae/4gmRUyI

EL INESPERADO POSTEO DE LA JOAQUI DESPUÉS DE SUS ÚLTIMAS APARICIONES PÚBLICAS: “DECIDIMOS SUSPENDER” | Por Martina Cortés A poco más de una semana de haber anunciado su separación de Luck Ra, La Joaqui atraviesa días en los que las emociones parecen no dar tregua. Entre rumores, exposiciones mediáticas y compromisos laborales, la referente de RKT eligió la sinceridad como refugio. Este fin de semana, su paso por PH, Podemos Hablar (Telefe), volvió a ponerla en el centro de la escena, no solo por sus declaraciones sobre el final de su relación sino también por las palabras dedicadas a Tuli Acosta, señalada como la tercera en discordia. Sin embargo, lejos de las especulaciones, la cantante decidió volcar sus sentimientos en un posteo contundente que compartió en sus historias de Instagram. Sobre un fondo negro y con un tono íntimo, La Joaqui se dirigió directamente a quienes la acompañan, pero también a quienes la observan desde la distancia: “Quería tomarme un momento para agradecerles por todos los mensajes de cariño, preocupación que recibí en estos días”. Enseguida, dejó en claro que la ruptura la tomó por sorpresa y que no siempre es posible “prepararse para actuar como si nada hubiera pasado”. “Al final del día, soy una persona tan común y corriente como cualquiera, transitando un desamor con todo lo que eso implica: días buenos, días difíciles y muchas emociones”, escribió, reconociendo que el dolor no distingue fama ni escenarios. “Por eso decidimos suspender las notas y apariciones que teníamos durante este mes”, contó. 🔗infob.ae/4wSnQ46

राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज यांच्या विचारांवर महाराष्ट्राच्या विकासाची वाटचाल मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते 'लोकराजा राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज' यांच्या पुर्णाकृती पुतळ्याचे अनावरण व कागल नगरीची 'ज्ञानदायिनी हिंदूराव घाटगे विद्यामंदिर' या नूतनीकृत शाळेचे लोकार्पण करण्यात आले. राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज यांनी सामाजिक, आर्थिक आणि शैक्षणिक क्रांतीच्या माध्यमातून बहुजन समाजासाठी शिक्षण आणि रोजगाराची दारे खुली केली. 1942 च्या ‘भारत छोडो’ आंदोलनाच्या क्रांतिकारी पर्वाच्या स्मरणदिनी अशा थोर समाजसुधारकाच्या पुतळ्याचे अनावरण करण्याचे भाग्य मिळणे ही आपल्यासाठी विशेष बाब आहे, असे यावेळी मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराजांनी आपल्या काळातील चुकीची सामाजिक व्यवस्था झुगारून नवी सामाजिक व्यवस्था निर्माण केली. त्यांनी आरक्षणाचा क्रांतिकारी निर्णय घेतला, मोफत शिक्षण सुरू केले, वंचितांसाठी विविध आनुषंगिक योजना राबवल्या आणि अस्पृश्यतेला गुन्हा मानून त्यावर बंदी घातली. महाराष्ट्राचे आराध्य दैवत छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराज यांनी दिलेला वारसा, डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकरांनी दिलेले संविधान आणि राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराजांनी दिलेले विचार या त्रिसूत्रीच्या आधारावर राज्य शासन काम करीत असल्याचे नमूद करत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. राधानगरी धरण हा राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज यांच्या दूरदृष्टीचा आणि अभियांत्रिकी कौशल्याचा आविष्कार असून, त्यांनी निर्माण केलेल्या जलसाठ्यांमुळे आजही जनतेला लाभ होत आहे. शेतकरी कर्जमाफीबाबत बोलताना मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, शेतकऱ्यांना दिलेले वचन पूर्ण करून आतापर्यंतची सर्वात मोठी कर्जमाफी देण्यात आली असून 56,000 शेतकऱ्यांना त्याचा लाभ झाला आहे. शेतकऱ्यांना मोफत वीज देण्यासाठी शासन दरवर्षी ₹25,000 कोटी खर्च करीत असून, ₹58,000 कोटींची थकबाकीही शासनाने दिली आहे. आता प्रत्येक शेतकऱ्याला थकबाकी नसल्याचे प्रमाणपत्र देण्यात येणार आहे. शेतकऱ्यांना दिवसा वीज उपलब्ध करून देण्यासाठी सौर कृषी वाहिनी योजनेला गती देण्यात आली असून, सध्या 74% शेतकऱ्यांना दिवसा वीज मिळत आहे. लवकरच 100% शेतकऱ्यांना दिवसा मोफत वीज उपलब्ध करून देण्याचे उद्दिष्ट असल्याचेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी अधोरेखित केले. साखर उद्योग आणि ऊस उत्पादक शेतकऱ्यांच्या हितासाठी इथेनॉल धोरण महत्त्वाचे असून, इथेनॉलशिवाय साखर कारखानदारी टिकवणे अवघड आहे. इथेनॉल धोरणामुळे साखर कारखानदारी टिकून राहिली असून, ऊस उत्पादकांना एफआरपी देणे शक्य झाले आहे. कोल्हापूर जिल्ह्यात एफआरपीचे नवे उच्चांक गाठले गेले असून, त्याचा लाभ ग्रामीण अर्थव्यवस्थेला आणि शेतकऱ्यांना झाला असल्याचे यावेळी मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. साखर कारखानदारी अधिक सक्षम करण्यासाठी ‘झिरो वेस्ट’ संकल्पनेतून स्पेंट वॉश आणि प्रेस मडपासून सीबीजी व सीएनजी निर्मिती करण्यात येणार आहे. या उपउत्पादनातून मिळणारा अतिरिक्त निधी कारखान्यांची आर्थिक स्थिती मजबूत करण्यासह शेतकऱ्यांच्या एफआरपीसाठी उपयोगात आणला जाणार आहे. देशातील पहिला एकत्रित सीबीजी प्रक्रिया प्रकल्प कोल्हापूर जिल्ह्यात उभारण्यात येणार असल्याचेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी नमूद केले. यावेळी विधानसभा अध्यक्ष ॲड. राहुल नार्वेकर, उपमुख्यमंत्री सुनेत्रा अजित पवार, मंत्री चंद्रकांत पाटील, मंत्री प्रकाश आबिटकर, राज्यमंत्री माधुरी मिसाळ, खासदार धनंजय महाडिक, कोल्हापूरच्या महापौर रुपाराणी निकम व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. Evers added: "But I anticipate that David will win." “You know, it’s the only time that I know that the governor — Tony Evers — the Republican Governors Association and Turning Point USA have ever been on the same page: in thinking that Francesca Hong is the best candidate to lose this race,” Crowley said in an interview later at the tavern. Hong’s allies bristle at Evers’ campaign against her, using his resources — including his own communications staff — to boost Crowley. लोकार्पण संपन्न झाले. कोल्हापूर शहराला अधिक सुनियोजित करण्यासाठी टप्प्याटप्प्याने आवश्यक त्या सर्व सोयीसुविधा देण्यात येतील, असे मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी सांगितले. संगीतसूर्य केशवराव भोसले नाट्यगृह संपूर्ण महाराष्ट्राचा मानबिंदू आहे, कोल्हापूरच्या देदिप्यमान नाट्यपरंपरेमध्ये या नाट्यगृहाचा फार मोठा इतिहास आहे. 14 ऑगस्ट 1915 रोजी छत्रपती राजाराम महाराज यांच्या हस्ते त्याचे उदघाटन झाले. पूर्वी 'पॅलेस थिएटर' म्हणून संबोधल्या जाणाऱ्या या नाट्यगृहाला 1957 पासून 'संगीतसूर्य केशवराव भोसले नाट्यगृह' म्हणून ओळखले जाऊ लागले. दुर्दैवाने 2 वर्षांपूर्वी या नाट्यगृहाला लागलेल्या आगीनंतर राज्य सरकारने या नाट्यगृहाची पुन्हा उभारणी करण्यासाठी तात्काळ निधी दिला. आधीचे बाह्यस्वरुप जतन करत वारसामूल्य जपून अत्यंत चांगल्या प्रकारे या नाट्यगृहाचे पुनर्निर्माण करण्यात आले आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. कोल्हापूरमध्ये खऱ्या अर्थाने संगीतसूर्य केशवराव भोसले यांचे योगदान कोणी विसरू शकत नाही, असे सांगून मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, संगीत मानापमान या नाटकामधील बालगंधर्व आणि केशवराव भोसले यांच्यातली जुगलबंदी ही मराठी संगीत नाटकाच्या इतिहासातील एक मर्मबंधाची ठेव आहे. संगीतसूर्य केशवराव भोसले यांच्या नावाच्या नाट्यगृहाने संगीत, शास्त्रीय संगीत, लोकनाट्य, लावणी, पोवाडा, तमाशा, दशावतार अशा आपल्या संस्कृतीचा महत्त्वाचा भाग असलेल्या बाबी पाहिल्या आहेत. या नाट्यगृहाच्या विस्तारीकरणासाठी आवश्यक त्या बाबी करण्यात येतील, असेही मुख्यमंत्री म्हणाले. नाट्यचळवळ, रंगभूमी असो किंवा चित्रपट या सर्व बाबींमध्ये कोल्हापूरचे मोठे योगदान नमूद करून मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी बाबूराव पेंटर, भालजी पेंढारकर, व्ही. शांताराम यांनी कोल्हापूरला एक वेगळी ओळख निर्माण करुन दिली असल्याचे स्पष्ट केले. पंडित विष्णू पलुसकर, दिगंबर पलुसकर, सुधीर उर्फ बाबूजी फडके, सुरेश वाडकर, वामनराव सडोलीकर असे अनेक दिग्गज गायक हे कोल्हापुरातले. पिराजीराव सरनाईक, अरुण सरनाईक, रमेश देव हे कलावंत याच कोल्हापुरातले. भारताला पहिल्यांदा ऑस्कर मिळवून देणाऱ्या वेशभूषाकार भानू अथय्या यांचीही कर्मभूमी कोल्हापूर शहर राहिली आहे, असे सांगून संगीतसूर्य केशवराव भोसले यांच्या नावाने असलेल्या या नाट्यगृहाचे पुन्हा एकदा नवनिर्मित रूपात उदघाटन होत असल्याबद्दल मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी आनंद व्यक्त केला. करवीर निवासिनी श्री क्षेत्र महालक्ष्मी अंबाबाई मंदिर येथे दर्शनासाठी देशभरातून भाविक येत असतात. या मंदिर परिसराच्या विकासाचे भूमिपूजन नुकतेच करण्यात आले असून निश्चित वेळेत ते काम पूर्ण करण्यात येईल, असे सांगून मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, कोल्हापूरमध्ये उच्च न्यायालयाचे सर्किट बेंच आले असून त्यासाठी शेंडा पार्क येथे 75 एकर जागा दिली आहे. या न्यायालयामुळे शहरात मोठ्या प्रमाणात नागरिक येणार आहेत. शेंडा पार्क येथे आयटी पार्क, कन्व्हेन्शन सेंटर ठिकाणी करतो आहोत या सर्व बाबींमुळे कोल्हापूरच्या विकासाला गती मिळणार असून त्यासाठी शहराच्या हद्दवाढीची गरज आहे. नव्याने हद्दवाढीमध्ये समावेशित कराव्या लागणाऱ्या नागरिकांच्या सर्व अडचणी शंभर टक्के सोडविण्यात येतील, असा विश्वासही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. सीपीआर म्हणजेच छत्रपती प्रमिलाराजे सर्वोपचार रुग्णालयाचे वारसा स्वरुप जतन करून चांगल्या प्रकारे पुनरुज्जीवन करण्यात आले आहे, असे सांगून मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, येथे 8 मॉड्युलर थिएटर्स असलेल्या ऑपरेशन थिएटर्सचे आधुनिकीकरण करण्यात आले आहे. चांगला मॉड्युलर बर्न वॉर्ड तयार झालेला आहे. 30 मॉड्युलर बेडचा अपघात विभाग, डायलिसिसची सुविधा आदी अनेक गोष्टींमुळे कोल्हापूरच्या आरोग्य सेवेमध्ये गुणात्मक बदल होत आहे. आता शेंडा पार्कमध्ये देखील 600 बेड सर्वोपचार रुग्णालय करण्यात येणार असून 250 बेडचे कर्करोग रुग्णालय आणि 250 बेडच्या सुपर स्पेशालिटी रुग्णालयाचा यात समावेश आहे. राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज यांच्या काळामध्ये ज्याप्रमाणे सर्वात चांगली आरोग्याची व्यवस्था ही कोल्हापूरला उभी झाली होती, त्याकडे आता पुन्हा कोल्हापूरने वाटचाल सुरू केलेली आहे, असेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. आपल्यासाठी 24 तास काम करणाऱ्या पोलिसांसाठी चांगल्या प्रकारची घरे असावीत ही भूमिका घेऊन राज्य सरकार काम करत असून महाराष्ट्रामध्ये पोलिसांकरता 50,000 घरांचे नियोजन केले आहे. कोल्हापूर येथील पोलिसांसाठी घराची 17 मजली सुंदर इमारत तयार झाली आहे. जवळपास 204 सदनिका छत्रपती महाराणी ताराराणी पोलीस गृहसंकुलात तर इचलकरंजीमध्ये 210 सदनिका अशा जवळपास 414 सदनिका पोलिसांकरता आज या जिल्ह्यामध्ये आपण उपलब्ध करून DE HIROSHIMA A STALINGRADO: ASÍ SE CONSTRUYÓ EL DOCUMENTAL ‘SEGUNDA GUERRA MUNDIAL CON TOM HANKS’ | Por Guillermo E. Pintos “Escucharlo leer la narración... hubo momentos en que se me pusieron los pelos de punta”, confiesa Mary Donahue, Vicepresidenta Sénior de Producción y Desarrollo de History Channel, sobre el trabajo junto al actor en Segunda Guerra Mundial con Tom Hanks, la serie documental de 20 episodios que reconstruye el conflicto más devastador del siglo XX a partir de material de archivo real, gran parte de él nunca visto públicamente. Mary Donahue ocupa su cargo desde 2017 y es responsable de supervisar toda la producción del canal, desde documentales dramáticos hasta series de no ficción. Ganadora de cuatro premios Emmy —con diez nominaciones personales y veinte obtenidas por los programas que desarrolló—, tiene detrás una trayectoria que incluye series sobre los presidentes Abraham Lincoln, Theodore Roosevelt y Franklin D. Roosevelt, producidas junto a la historiadora Doris Kearns Goodwin, y proyectos con figuras como Leonardo DiCaprio y Kevin Costner. La producción que ahora presenta, resultado de más de diez años de trabajo, abarca el conflicto en toda su magnitud: desde el ascenso del nazismo y el expansionismo japonés hasta la caída de las potencias del Eje y el surgimiento del nuevo orden mundial posterior a 1945. Los 20 episodios recorren las batallas más decisivas —Stalingrado, el Día D, la ofensiva final sobre Berlín y el desenlace nuclear en Hiroshima y Nagasaki— y se adentran también en aspectos menos explorados, como las operaciones de inteligencia vinculadas al código Enigma, la resistencia clandestina en los territorios ocupados y el costo humano del Holocausto. “Rastrear todo ese archivo, conseguir los derechos, encontrar todas las fotos y el material filmado, y asegurarnos de usarlos de manera responsable y emotiva fue realmente desafiante, pero también muy gratificante”, señala Donahue desde su casa en las afueras de Nueva York (con mucho calor, señala). A través de una videollamada, la responsable de producción de esta monumental serie documental habló con Infobae Cultura sobre el proceso de producción, el rol central de Tom Hanks y el desafío de abordar episodios tan complejos como los bombardeos sobre Hiroshima y Nagasaki sin caer en una sola mirada parcial. 🔗infob.ae/4wfSKlC

DE UNA GUERRA AJENA CONTRA CHILE A LA CASA ROSADA: LA HISTORIA DE ROQUE SÁENZ PEÑA Y LA LEY QUE TERMINÓ CON EL FRAUDE ELECTORAL | Por Adrián Pignatelli Era un conservador aristócrata de pura cepa, que a los 59 años había llegado a la presidencia gracias al fraude pero que se había propuesto terminarlo. Por cuestiones de salud, vivió en la Casa Rosada, donde hacía vestir a sus ordenanzas con un uniforme de los tiempos del rey Luis XIV. Rápidamente la calle apodó a este consumado gourmet y experimentado catador de vinos como Roque I. El mismo, como parte de su habitual vestimenta, usaba capa, sin importarle el qué dirán. Roque José Antonio del Sagrado Corazón de Jesús Sáenz Peña había nacido en Buenos Aires el 19 de marzo de 1851, en el seno de una familia rosista. Estudió en el Colegio Nacional de Buenos Aires y se graduó en Derecho. Era un jovencito cuando se sumó al ejército en el Regimiento 2 para defender al gobierno contra la revolución de Bartolomé Mitre de 1874. Enrolado en el Partido Autonomista, fue electo legislador y llegó a la presidencia del cuerpo a los 26 años. Pero en 1878 se alejó de la política por desavenencias dentro de la agrupación. 🔗infob.ae/4hZ4QMt

LOS SILVERS DEL FUTURO: CUANDO LA CIENCIA CONSIGA DERROTAR AL ENVEJECIMIENTO | Por Alejandro Portabales Durante miles de años la humanidad dio por sentado que la vida tenía un recorrido inevitable: nacer, crecer, envejecer y morir. Sobre esa certeza construimos nuestras sociedades, nuestras economías y hasta nuestras creencias religiosas. Pero ¿qué ocurriría si ese ciclo dejara de ser una ley de la naturaleza y pasara a convertirse en un problema médico? ¿Qué sucedería si la biología lograra regenerar nuestras células indefinidamente y el envejecimiento pudiera tratarse como hoy se trata una enfermedad? Lejos de ser una fantasía literaria, esta posibilidad comienza a ocupar un lugar cada vez más importante en los laboratorios más prestigiosos del mundo. El genetista David Sinclair, de la Universidad de Harvard, sostiene que el envejecimiento es, en buena medida, un proceso biológico reversible. Sus investigaciones han conseguido rejuvenecer tejidos en animales mediante la reprogramación del epigenoma. A ello se suman los descubrimientos del premio Nobel Shinya Yamanaka, cuyos factores de reprogramación demostraron que una célula adulta puede volver a un estado semejante al embrionario, abriendo un camino completamente nuevo para la medicina regenerativa. También son fundamentales los trabajos de la premio Nobel Elizabeth Blackburn sobre la telomerasa y los telómeros, estrechamente relacionados con el envejecimiento celular, así como las investigaciones del español Juan Carlos Izpisúa Belmonte, quien logró rejuvenecer parcialmente distintos órganos en modelos animales. Autor intelectual del cuestionado proyecto de inviolabilidad de la propiedad privada, el ministro fatigó esa noche el teléfono en la sala VIP del aeropuerto de esa ciudad antes de embarcarse en el vuelo DM6266 de Arajet que lo devolvería al país en la mañana siguiente, en la previa de la sesión del Senado, junto a uno de sus máximos colaboradores que lo acompañó hasta República Dominicana, y que no dudó en ponerse el traje de baño para disfrutar de la piscina descubierta que ofrece una vista privilegiada de los aviones y las pistas de aterrizaje. “El Gobierno tiene que entender que no se puede mandar cualquier cosa: se ponen objetivos que después no se pueden cumplir”, se quejaría en la mañana del viernes un integrante de la mesa política del Ejecutivo en reunión con su equipo de trabajo. El paso en falso en el Senado del gobierno, que le dio media sanción a un proyecto rengo después de ceder en dos de sus principales capítulos -la ley de tierras y la ley de manejo del fuego-, expuso un problema más profundo que la discusión en torno a la iniciativa redactada por el ministro de Desregulación, cada vez más cuestionado puertas adentro: la disociación de la agenda y el relato oficial con los problemas cotidianos de los argentinos. También el funcionamiento de la mesa política y el rol de sus integrantes, y la crisis de la narrativa libertaria para imponer la agenda de Javier Milei en la conversación pública: “El aparato comunicacional está destruido”, resaltó un dirigente destacadísimo. 🔗infob.ae/4q55KJr

“ME PASÉ LA VIDA FINGIENDO QUE NO ME DOLÍA” | Por Juan Tonelli Mamá se enojaba conmigo porque decía que yo no me daba cuenta de nada. En realidad, la que no se daba cuenta era ella. Yo percibía todo. Desde muy chica aprendí a hacerme la boluda. A actuar como si la realidad no me tocara, como si las cosas malas no me dolieran. Pero me dolían. Muchísimo. Solo que descubrí que era más seguro fingir que mostrar lo que sentía. Mamá vivía comparándonos. Siempre parecía que alguien era nosotras, más inteligente, menos torpe, más capaz. Nunca alcanzaba nada. Sin darse cuenta nos fue enseñando a mirarnos con los mismos ojos con los que ella se miraba: los de alguien que jamás terminaba de sentirse suficiente. No quería hacernos daño, pero era inevitable con todas las heridas que cargaba. Porque los hijos no solo reciben las intenciones de sus padres, sino especialmente sus palabras, sus silencios, sus miradas, sus miedos. Y todo eso, cuando uno es chico, se mete muy adentro. 🔗infob.ae/3S1HSd3

El líder del Frente Renovador estuvo en contacto con algunos senadores del espacio durante el día previo a la sesión y durante todo su desarrollo. Teléfono en mano, se volcó al campo de la negociación parlamentaria para frenar la ley. La senadora nacional Juliana Di Tullio lo dejó a la vista en un mensaje encriptado en sus redes sociales. Escribió: “El pueblo argentino logró lo impoSible: que este gobierno enTreguista tenga que bajar dos capítulos claves del proyecto de inviolabilidad.La ley de tierras y la ley de Manejo del fuego siguen vigentes”. The UK’s @AISecurityInst (AISI) has published a report on their recent cybersecurity evaluation of Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 and OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol. The models attempted to complete an assignment in a setup where their normal safeguards were removed and they were deliberately given internet access. AISI reports that the models “engaged in sustained, potentially harmful activity directed at real people and organisations”. We’re grateful to AISI for their leadership in the important discussion about how to evaluate increasingly capable AI agents. We’re working closely with them to gather more details of the incident as we conduct our own investigation. Gaining a clear picture of Claude’s understanding of its situation—by examining its reasoning transcripts and running our own analyses—will help us identify the causes of its behavior. The prompts in the evaluation did not impose any specific restrictions on how the internet should be used. This and the removal of safeguards meant that the models were tested under “deliberately permissive conditions” that are not representative of any of our production models. Note that there was no evidence here of an escape from a secure environment. AISI’s disclosure of the incident can be found here: aisi.gov.uk/blog/incident-re…

আবারও হাইকোর্টে প্রতারণার আশ্রয়: আইনজীবীকে ২৫ হাজার টাকা জরিমানা হাইকোর্টে মামলা তালিকাভুক্ত করে প্রতারণার আশ্রয়ে জামিন নেওয়ার চেষ্টা—এমন অভিযোগে এক আইনজীবীকে ২৫ হাজার টাকা জরিমানা করেছেন সুপ্রিম কোর্টের হাইকোর্ট বিভাগের একটি বেঞ্চ। বিচারপতি শেখ জাকির হোসেন ও বিচারপতি মোঃ জাকির হোসেনের সমন্বয়ে গঠিত বেঞ্চে আজ রবিবার, ৯ আগস্ট ২০২৬, ১৫ নম্বর সিরিয়ালে (টেন্ডার নং–৫০৮১১) আসামি সাকিব ওরফে সাকিব হাসান লিটনের জামিনের আবেদন শুনানির জন্য তালিকাভুক্ত ছিল। শুনানির সময় আদালতের দায়িত্বে থাকা ডেপুটি অ্যাটর্নি জেনারেল সুলতান মাহমুদ বান্না আদালতের দৃষ্টি আকর্ষণ করে জানান যে, একই মামলাটি এর আগে হাইকোর্টের ভিন্ন একটি বেঞ্চে শুনানি হয়েছে। কিন্তু পূর্ববর্তী শুনানির বিষয়টি গোপন করে মামলাটি পুনরায় তালিকাভুক্ত করা হয়েছে বলে অভিযোগ করেন তিনি। বিষয়টি আদালতের নজরে আসার পর সংশ্লিষ্ট আইনজীবী মোহাম্মদ আজিজুর রহমানকে আদালত এ বিষয়ে ব্যাখ্যা দিতে বলেন। কিন্তু তিনি সন্তোষজনক কোনো জবাব দিতে পারেননি। পরবর্তীতে আদালত মামলাটি সরাসরি খারিজ করে দেন এবং আদালতের সঙ্গে প্রতারণার আশ্রয় নেওয়ার অভিযোগে সংশ্লিষ্ট আইনজীবীকে ২৫ হাজার টাকা জরিমানা করেন। এ বিষয়ে অ‍্যাটর্নি-জেনারেল ব‍্যারিস্টার রুহুল কুদ্দুস কাজল বলেন, “আদালতের প্রতি পূর্ণাঙ্গ ও নির্ভুল তথ্য উপস্থাপন করা একজন আইনজীবীর মৌলিক পেশাগত দায়িত্ব। একই বিষয়ে একাধিক বেঞ্চে শুনানির সুযোগ তৈরি করা কিংবা পূর্ববর্তী কার্যক্রম গোপন করে আদালতের আদেশ প্রভাবিত করার চেষ্টা শুধু পেশাগত নৈতিকতার পরিপন্থী নয়—এটি বিচারপ্রক্রিয়ার প্রতি আস্থাকেও প্রশ্নবিদ্ধ করে।” #BangladeshJudiciary #HighCourt #LegalNews #somoytv

মহানবী হজরত মুহাম্মদ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লামের জীবন ও আদর্শকে দেশব্যাপী শিশু-কিশোর, শিক্ষার্থী এবং সর্বস্তরের মানুষের কাছে পৌঁছে দেওয়ার লক্ষ্যে ‘মহানবী (সা.)-এর জীবনীভিত্তিক জাতীয় সাধারণ জ্ঞান প্রতিযোগিতা-২০২৬’ আয়োজন করেছে আওয়ার ইসলাম। প্রতিযোগিতায় অংশগ্রহণের জন্য গুগল ফরম পুরো করে নিবন্ধন করতে হবে। ৩০০ টাকার বিনিময়ে প্রতিযোগীদের কাছে কুরিয়ারে পাঠিয়ে দেওয়া হবে ‘আমাদের নবীজি’ বইটি। বিজয়ীদের জন্য পবিত্র ওমরাহ পালনসহ পাঁচ লক্ষাধিক টাকার পুরস্কার। আয়োজকরা জানান, গত ২১ জুলাই থেকে প্রতিযোগিতার নিবন্ধন শুরু হয়েছে, যা চলবে আগামী ২৮ আগস্ট পর্যন্ত। নিবন্ধনের পর ২৯ আগস্ট থেকে ৪ সেপ্টেম্বর পর্যন্ত অংশগ্রহণকারীদের ঠিকানায় কুরিয়ারের মাধ্যমে বই পাঠানো হবে। প্রতিযোগিতাটি স্কুল, কলেজ, বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, মাদরাসার শিক্ষার্থীসহ সব শ্রেণি-পেশার নারী-পুরুষের জন্য উন্মুক্ত। বিশিষ্ট লেখক ও মুহাদ্দিস মাওলানা মুহাম্মদ যাইনুল আবিদীন রচিত ‘আমাদের নবীজি’ বই থেকে প্রশ্ন করা হবে। আয়োজকরা জানায়, ‘আমাদের নবীজি’ গ্রন্থ অবলম্বনে বিশেষজ্ঞদের একটি দল ৫০টি বহুনির্বাচনি (এমসিকিউ) প্রশ্ন তৈরি করবে। অংশগ্রহণকারীদের বইটি মনোযোগ সহকারে পড়ে পরীক্ষায় অংশ নিতে হবে। আগামী ৯ অক্টোবর সকাল ১০টায় ৩০ মিনিটব্যাপী পরীক্ষা অনুষ্ঠিত হবে। ফলাফল প্রকাশ করা হবে ১৫ অক্টোবর রাতে। প্রতিযোগিতায় অংশ নিতে গুগল ফরমের মাধ্যমে নিবন্ধন করতে হবে। বইয়ের মূল্য ও কুরিয়ার খরচ বাবদ ৩০০ টাকা পরিশোধের মাধ্যমে নিবন্ধন সম্পন্ন হবে। নিবন্ধন সম্পন্নকারীদের ঠিকানায় ‘আমাদের নবীজি’ বইটি পাঠিয়ে দেওয়া হবে। এছাড়া তাদের একটি প্রাইভেট হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ গ্রুপে যুক্ত করা হবে, যেখানে পরীক্ষার প্রস্তুতি ও প্রয়োজনীয় দিকনির্দেশনা দেওয়া হবে। প্রতিযোগিতায় মোট ৭৫ জন বিজয়ী পাঁচ লাখ টাকারও বেশি মূল্যের পুরস্কার পাবেন। পুরস্কারের মধ্যে রয়েছে— প্রথম পুরস্কার: ওমরাহ (১ জন); দ্বিতীয় পুরস্কার: ৫০ হাজার টাকা (১ জন); তৃতীয় পুরস্কার: ৩০ হাজার টাকা (১ জন); ৪র্থ থেকে ২৫তম: জনপ্রতি ২ হাজার টাকা (মোট ২২ জন); ২৬তম থেকে ৭৫তম: জনপ্রতি ৫ হাজার টাকা সমমূল্যের বই (মোট ৫০ জন)। আয়োজকরা জানিয়েছেন, আওয়ার ইসলাম পরিবার এবং বিচারকাজের সঙ্গে যুক্ত কোনো সদস্য এ প্রতিযোগিতায় অংশ নিতে পারবেন না। এছাড়া প্রযুক্তিগত বা নেটওয়ার্কজনিত সমস্যার কারণে কেউ পরীক্ষায় অংশ নিতে না পারলে তার দায়ভার কর্তৃপক্ষ নেবে না। নির্ধারিত সময়ের মধ্যেই উত্তর জমা দিতে হবে এবং প্রতিযোগিতা-সংক্রান্ত যেকোনো নিয়ম পরিবর্তন বা চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত গ্রহণের অধিকার আয়োজক কর্তৃপক্ষ সংরক্ষণ করবে। #IslamicKnowledge #IslamicEducation #Umrah #somoytv

धडधाकट शरीरयष्टी, कणखर आवाज, शिस्त आणि दरारा हे त्यांचे गुण वाखाणण्यासारखे आहेत. तळागाळातील जनतेचे प्रश्न प्रशासकीय पकड व सखोल अभ्यास याद्वारे त्यांनी सोडवले असून, महाराष्ट्राला टँकरमुक्त करण्यासाठी आपल्या मंत्रिपदाच्या काळात त्यांनीच पुढाकार घेतला आणि प्रत्येक गावात पिण्याचे पाणी मिळण्यासाठी नियोजन करून महाराष्ट्र जीवन प्राधिकरणची स्थापनाही केली. 80 च्या दशकाच्या शेवटी अण्णासाहेब यांनी शेतकऱ्यांच्या कर्जमाफीच्या लढ्यात सक्रिय सहभाग घेतला. या लढ्याला राजकीय स्वरूप देऊन शेतकऱ्यांच्या हक्काचा हा लढा व्यापक केला. तळागाळात जायचे असेल तर शेतकऱ्यांचे प्रश्न महत्त्वाचे आहेत, याची जाणीव त्यांना होती. त्यामुळे आज शेतकऱ्यांसाठी कर्जमाफी करूनच आपण इथे आल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. राज्य शासनाने 56 लाख शेतकऱ्यांची कर्जमाफी केली असून, त्यापैकी सुमारे 6,22,207 शेतकऱ्यांच्या खात्यावर पहिल्या टप्प्यात सुमारे ₹5029 कोटी जमा केले असल्याचे सांगून उर्वरित शेतकऱ्यांच्या खात्यावर 2 महिन्यात पैसे जमा होतील, तसेच कर्जाची प्रामाणिकपणे वेळेवर परतफेड करणाऱ्या शेतकऱ्यांच्याही खात्यात ₹50000 जमा होतील असे त्यांनी सांगितले. मुघलांच्या काळात देशभरातील हिंदू देवतांच्या मूर्ती आणि मंदिरांची विटंबना केली गेली होती. त्या देवालयांचा व घाटांचा जीर्णोद्धार ज्या पुण्यश्लोक राजमाता अहिल्यादेवी होळकर यांनी केला. त्यांच्या चौंडी या जन्मस्थानाचा शोध डॉ. अण्णासाहेब डांगे यांनी घेतला आणि त्याचा जीर्णोद्धार केला. तसेच, वाटेगाव येथील लोकशाहीर अण्णाभाऊ साठे यांच्या स्मारकाचे कामही त्यांनी सुरू केले. त्यांचे कार्य आता पुढे नेत असून पुण्यश्लोक राजमाता अहिल्यादेवी होळकर यांच्या चौंडी येथील जन्मस्थान विकासासाठी राज्य शासनाने ₹700 कोटींचा विकास आराखडा केला आहे. तसेच, लोकशाहीर अण्णाभाऊ साठे यांच्या स्मारकासाठी वाढीव भूसंपादनाचे काम पूर्ण झाले असून, त्यांच्या भव्य स्मारकाचेही काम सुरू आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. सामाजिक क्षेत्राबरोबर शैक्षणिक कार्य करताना डॉ. अण्णासाहेब डांगे यांनी महाराष्ट्रातील सर्वोत्तम आश्रमशाळा उभी केली आहे. अनेक आव्हानांच्या काळातही दीनदयाळ सूतगिरणी चांगल्या पद्धतीने सुरू आहे. अण्णांना जडीबुटींचे उत्तम ज्ञान असून, ते त्यांचा वापर How can investments strengthen Indigenous Peoples’ socio-economic power while giving due weight to Indigenous food systems, traditional knowledge and cultural identity? There are more than 476 million Indigenous Peoples across 90 countries, making up an estimated 6% of the world’s population. IFAD supports Indigenous Peoples’ economies by strengthening Indigenous enterprises rooted in traditional knowledge and local resources. Launched in 2007, IFAD’s Indigenous Peoples Assistance Facility (IPAF) was set up to provide grants to finance projects that foster self-driven development. To date, IPAF has invested in 212 projects in over 45 countries and raised around US$15 million, including through partnerships with bilateral donors and private foundations. By recognizing Indigenous Peoples’ cultural heritage, traditional knowledge and identity as assets, these investments have fostered self-driven development for Indigenous Peoples. In eastern #India, IFAD partnered with the Government of Odisha to support Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups through the OPELIP project (2016–2023). The project provided land titles to 14,446 households and helped them adopt better farming practices. As a result, average household food production rose from 510 kg to 1,300 kg per year, and household incomes grew nearly six-fold, to US$203 a year. On the International Day of the World’s #IndigenousPeoples, explore how IFAD supports Indigenous Peoples’ economies at bit.ly/4w2Fgtx

ବିଜୁ ଜନତା ଦଳ ଜନଜାତି ଭାଇଭଉଣୀଙ୍କ ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ ବନ୍ଧୁ। ସଭାପତି ଶ୍ରୀ @Naveen_Odisha ଙ୍କ ନେତୃତ୍ବରେ ​ଜନଜାତିଙ୍କ ଅଧିକାର ଓ ସାଂସ୍କୃତିକ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ବିଜେଡିର ଲଢ଼େଇ ଜାରି ରହିବ। ଶଙ୍ଖ ଭବନରେ ବିଶ୍ୱ ଆଦିମ ଜନଜାତି ଦିବସ ପାଳିତ ହୋଇଯାଇଛି। ଏହି ଅବସରରେ ଆୟୋଜିତ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମରେ ସଭାପତି ଯୋଗଦେଇ ୧୬୯ଟି ଜନଜାତି ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀକୁ ST ମାନ୍ୟତା ଦେବା ପାଇଁ ଦାବି କରିଛନ୍ତି। ଆହୁରି ମଧ୍ୟ, ବିଜୁ ଜନତା ଦଳ ସରକାର ସମୟରେ ଜନଜାତି ବର୍ଗର ବିକାଶ ପାଇଁ ଅନେକ ଯୁଗାନ୍ତକାରୀ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା। ଉଚ୍ଚଶିକ୍ଷାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଜୀବନଜୀବିକା ଆଦି ବିଭିନ୍ନ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରର ବିକାଶ କରି ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ସଶକ୍ତ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଅନେକ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ନିଆଯାଇଥିଲା। ବିଜୁ ଜନତା ଦଳକୁ ଜନଜାତି ଭାଇଭଉଣୀମାନଙ୍କର ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ ବନ୍ଧୁ ବୋଲି ସଭାପତି କହିଛନ୍ତି। ପଞ୍ଚାୟତକୁ ଜଙ୍ଗଲଜାତ ଦ୍ରବ୍ୟ ସଂଗ୍ରହର ଅଧିକାର ଜନଜାତିଙ୍କୁ ଦିଆଯାଇଥିଲା। ହଜାର ହଜାର ହଷ୍ଟେଲ ନିର୍ମାଣ, ଉଚ୍ଚଶିକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ 'ଅନ୍ୱେଷା' କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଏବଂ ଜଙ୍ଗଲ ଜମି ଅଧିକାର ଆଦି ଜନଜାତି ଭାଇଭଉଣୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ବିକାଶ ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ିପାରିଥିଲା। ଆଦିବାସୀ ଭାଇଭଉଣୀମାନଙ୍କ ଅଧିକାର ଓ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ସଂସ୍କୃତିର ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ବିଜେଡି ସବୁବେଳେ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ସହ ଦୃଢ଼ ଭାବରେ ଛିଡ଼ା ହୋଇଆସିଛି। ବିଜେଡି ସରକାର ସମୟରେ ୨୩ଟି ଜିଲ୍ଲାରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଥିବା ‘ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର ଉନ୍ନୟନ ପରିଷଦ’ ଆଦିବାସୀଙ୍କ କଳା ଓ ସଂସ୍କୃତିର ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ଏକ ଅନନ୍ୟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ଥିଲା, ଆଦିବାସୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ବିକାଶର ସମାନ ଭାଗୀଦାର କରିପାରିଥିଲା। ଏହାଦ୍ୱାରା ସେମାନେ ନିଜର ଜୀବିକାରେ ଉନ୍ନତି ଆଣିବା ସହ ନିଜର ପବିତ୍ର ପୀଠ, କଳା, କାରୁକାର୍ଯ୍ୟ, ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ଓ ପରମ୍ପରାର ସୁରକ୍ଷା ନିଜେ କରିବାର ସୁଯୋଗ ପାଇଛନ୍ତି। ଜନଜାତି ଭାଇଭଉଣୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ସଶକ୍ତ କରି ସମ୍ମାନର ସହ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ନିଜ ମାଟିରେ ବାସ କରିବାର ସୁଯୋଗ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିବା ବିଜେଡି ସରକାରର ନୀତି ଥିଲା। ଜନଜାତି ଭାଇଭଉଣୀମାନଙ୍କ ସଶକ୍ତିକରଣ କେବଳ ଏକ ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ନଥିଲା, ବରଂ ବିଜେଡି ସରକାରର ସମସ୍ତ ଜନଜାତି ବିକାଶ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମର ଏହା କେନ୍ଦ୍ରବିନ୍ଦୁ ଥିଲା ବୋଲି ସଭାପତି ନବୀନ ପଟ୍ଟନାୟକ କହିଛନ୍ତି। ଜନଜାତି ଭାଇଭଉଣୀମାନଙ୍କ ଜ୍ଞାନକୁ ସମ୍ମାନ ଦେବା ସହ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ସଂସ୍କୃତିର ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ନିଷ୍ଠାପର ଭାବରେ କାମ କରିବାକୁ ସଭାପତି ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ପରାମର୍ଶ ଦେଇଛନ୍ତି। #BJDWithTribals #BJDWithPeople #BJD4Odisha

Mullah Abdul Ghani Baradar, Deputy Prime Minister for Economic Affairs, inaugurated and officially opened a standard laboratory for testing the quality of food, medicines, and health products for the southwestern region during his visit to Herat today (Sunday). Speaking at the inauguration ceremony, the Deputy Prime Minister for Economic Affairs said that products and services should meet national and international standards and that established standards for imported products should also be properly observed. Baradar highlighted the importance of standard laboratories, saying they help ensure the quality and reliability of products and goods. According to him, the quality and reliability of food, medicines, and health products imported into Afghanistan from neighboring and other countries will now be tested at this laboratory. Abdul Salam Hanafi, Deputy Prime Minister for Administrative Affairs, and several members of the Islamic Emirate’s cabinet also attended the inauguration ceremony. #TOLOnews_English

PIDIÓ UNA INSPECCIÓN URGENTE POR UN PINO CON RIESGO DE CAÍDA, EL MUNICIPIO DEMORÓ EL TRÁMITE Y EL ÁRBOL TERMINÓ APLASTANDO SU CASA: DEBERÁN INDEMNIZARLO La Cámara de Apelación en lo Contencioso Administrativo de San Martín confirmó un fallo que condenó a una municipalidad a pagar una suma indemnizatoria a un vecino afectado por la caída de un árbol de gran porte en su propiedad. El tribunal consideró que existió una responsabilidad directa del municipio por omisión en el ejercicio de su poder de policía y falta de intervención oportuna en una zona ecológicamente protegida, lo que derivó en la obligación de resarcir económicamente al reclamante por los daños sufridos. El episodio tuvo origen el 25 de octubre de 2021, cuando un pino de grandes dimensiones se desplomó dentro del predio del demandante en una zona declarada como área ecológicamente protegida. Las pruebas reunidas en el expediente confirmaron que la caída del árbol produjo daños materiales en diversos bienes de la vivienda, incluyendo el alambrado, la piscina, la caldera y otras estructuras, además de generar un contexto de angustia y temor en la familia afectada. Según la sentencia de primera instancia, dictada el 10 de diciembre de 2024, la municipalidad fue condenada a abonar $5.200.000 en concepto de daño material y $2.000.000 como daño moral, más intereses y actualización por el Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) hasta el pago efectivo. El fallo reconoció que la autoridad local no cumplió con sus deberes legales ante los reclamos de urgencia realizados por el propietario afectado, quien había solicitado la intervención municipal para prevenir el siniestro. 🔗infob.ae/3TNAKBJ

UN HOMBRE RECORRIÓ 50 KM EN LA NIEVE PARA RESCATAR A UNA EMBARAZADA AISLADA EN NEUQUÉN En medio de un fuerte temporal de nieve en Neuquén, que dejó la Ruta Provincial 13 casi intransitable, una embarazada quedó aislada a unos 50 kilómetros de Villa Pehuenia. Se realizó un operativo particular para rescatar a la mujer, quien cursa su primer embarazo y se encontraba a solo ocho días de la fecha prevista para el parto cuando quedó varada en el sector de Kilca. La joven, llamada Mercedes, permanecía en el denominado Puesto Azul junto a su esposo, Juan, sin posibilidades de salir del campo desde hacía unas 48 horas. De acuerdo con Diario Neuquino, la acumulación de nieve bloqueó los accesos habituales e impidió la circulación de vehículos convencionales en la zona de la cordillera de la provincia. Frente a ese cuadro, Ariel Marimon, de 50 años e integrante de Wildtrak Aventura 4×4, recibió el aviso mientras se encontraba en Villa Pehuenia. El vecino decidió avanzar hacia el paraje con una camioneta preparada para circular en condiciones extremas, con el objetivo de retirar a la embarazada antes de que el cuadro logístico se volviera todavía más complejo. 🔗infob.ae/4xvo01a

Indigenous knowledge has immense value. The right investment can turn that value into jobs, stronger businesses and more resilient rural economies. I saw this first-hand last year in Michoacán, Mexico, when I visited Purépecha communities supported by @IFAD. For generations, communities there have sustainably managed their forests and passed down skills such as pine resin tapping. Targeted investment is now driving local processing of that resin into higher-value products, strengthening value chains and generating income while protecting the forests they depend on. The same principle is delivering results elsewhere. In Peru, investment is unlocking opportunities for Indigenous communities to commercialize medicinal plants. In Bolivia, it has strengthened traditional alpaca and llama production against climate shocks. This is an important lesson for development finance. We do not need to choose between preserving ancestral knowledge and creating economic opportunity. With the right financing, we can do both. More than 40% of IFAD’s loan portfolio contributes to initiatives targeting Indigenous Peoples. On Indigenous Peoples Day, we remain committed to investing with Indigenous Peoples as partners in building resilient and inclusive rural economies. Their knowledge and leadership strengthen democracy, advance human rights and contribute to inclusive and sustainable growth. On the International Day of the World’s Indigenous Peoples, we reaffirm the enduring value of Indigenous knowledge systems, our commitment to equal rights, greater opportunity and meaningful inclusion. Indigenous Peoples and local communities, women and young people are not simply affected by the challenges we face. They are leaders and partners whose experience, ideas and agency must help shape Commonwealth decisions and action. #IndigenousPeoplesDay

Not for skin colors. Still, worth watching.

En ese contexto, Bernardo Blejmar propone repensar cómo se forman y se seleccionan los equipos directivos, pero también cómo se los acompaña desde la política educativa. Blejmar defiende una mayor autonomía para las escuelas, con una advertencia: esa autonomía no puede convertirse en abandono estatal. Un “salto al vacío” –afirma– profundizaría las desigualdades que ya existen. Blejmar plantea estas ideas en Por un nuevo posible en la gestión escolar. A propósito del rol directivo en tiempos de confusión, el libro que presentará en el XVII Foro Latinoamericano de Educación, organizado por Fundación Santillana y la OEI el miércoles 12 y jueves 13 de agosto, con apoyo de IIPE Unesco y la Biblioteca del Congreso. Licenciado en Ciencias de la Educación por la UBA, consultor y autor de varios libros sobre gestión y liderazgo, Blejmar conversó con Infobae y cuestionó que la antigüedad sea el principal criterio para acceder a la dirección, reclamó una formación específica para el cargo y propuso mentorías, trabajo en red y mayores márgenes de decisión para quienes conducen las escuelas. 🔗infob.ae/4hGZDsT

The link can accelerate movement of troops, artillery, ammunition and engineering equipment while reducing dependence on landslide-prone mountain roads. Crucially, it adds logistical redundancy around the sensitive Siliguri Corridor and can shorten mobilisation timelines toward forward sectors. China already possesses extensive rail-road infrastructure across Tibet. India is steadily strengthening the logistics depth on its side. In mountain warfare, firepower matters. But the ability to reinforce, resupply and sustain it can decide the fight. 🇮🇳

ملا عبدالغنی برادر، معاون اقتصادی ریاست‌الوزرا، امروز (یکشنبه، ۱۸ اسد) در جریان سفر به هرات، لابراتوار معیاری ارزیابی کیفیت مواد غذایی، دوا و محصولات صحی در سطح حوزه جنوب‌غرب را در این ولایت افتتاح و به بهره‌برداری سپرده است. معاون اقتصادی ریاست‌الوزرا در مراسم افتتاح این لابراتوار گفته است که محصولات و خدمات باید مطابق با معیارهای ملی و بین‌المللی ارایه شوند و معیارهای تعیین‌شده در بخش واردات محصولات نیز به‌گونه درست رعایت گردند. آقای برادر فعالیت لابراتوارهای معیاری را در این زمینه مهم دانسته و گفته است که از این طریق، کیفیت و اعتبار محصولات و تولیدات تضمین می‌شود. به گفته او، پس از این، کیفیت و اعتبار مواد غذایی، دوا و محصولات صحی وارداتی از کشورهای همسایه و سایر کشورها به افغانستان، در این لابراتوار ارزیابی خواهد شد. در مراسم افتتاح این لابراتوار، عبدالسلام حنفی، معاون اداری ریاست‌الوزرا، و شماری از اعضای کابینه امارت اسلامی نیز حضور داشته‌اند. #طلوع‌نیوز

Turkey’s Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan says the new defence pact will provide mutual security guarantees for Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, as well as any other countries that join the pact. Fidan said an attack on one member would be considered an attack on all, describing the principle as technically similar to NATO’s Article 5. However, he stressed that this would not necessarily mean an immediate military intervention. The country under attack would request the assistance it needs, which could range from intelligence, logistics and ammunition to military units, depending on the scale of the threat. Fidan also said the pact is not simply aimed at outside threats. He said the countries joining the alliance are committing to each other’s security and ensuring that nothing harmful or damaging comes from one member towards another. The pact will establish a ministerial political and military committee and a General Secretariat to oversee decisions and their implementation. The members will also work on military interoperability, joint training, logistics, intelligence sharing, threat assessments and defence industry cooperation. Video

1/5 ThePrint assigned a stellar team of reporters to investigate what happens to a family when an exam becomes the centre of a child's life, and then the system tells them to start all over again? ThePrint reporters travelled across India and met the families of 16 students who died by suicide in the aftermath of the NEET paper leak and re-examination. 2/5 For these families, their children's dream of becoming a doctor had taken over everything. Parents had borrowed money, sold land and mortgaged homes to pay for books, laptops and coaching. Years of preparation and long hours of study almost paid off on 3 May—nearly every student had called home happy after the exam. 3/5 But the cancellation meant another round of preparation after students believed their ordeal was finally over. Some went straight back to their books. Others stopped eating and stopped talking. Families didn't see the difference until it was too late. 4/5 "Students shouldn't feel one exam decides whether they deserve to live," one mother told us. The families are now left with their children's books, final conversations, unanswered questions, guilt and suicide notes. 5/5 Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Jharkhand, Uttarakhand, Delhi, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat — 16 families across the country forced to live in the long shadow of NEET paper leak. France’s Safran has significantly expanded its footprint in India regarding the M88 engine (which powers the Dassault Rafale) through a mix of high-level industrial commitments, localized manufacturing collaborations, and specialized infrastructure: 1. The M88 MRO Facility in Hyderabad Safran established a dedicated Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) facility for the M88 engine in Hyderabad. This is Safran's first MRO facility for the M88 outside of France. It services the engines used by the Indian Air Force's Rafale fleet as well as the Indian Navy's Rafale-M variants, alongside potential regional export customers. Previously, these complex engine modules had to be flown back to France for heavy maintenance. 2. Local Production and Assembly Readiness While Safran and Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) have long-standing joint ventures (such as SAFHAL for helicopter engines like the Shakti) and cooperate heavily on civil LEAP engine components, discussions regarding the full local assembly and manufacturing of the M88 have scaled up alongside mega-defense procurement talks (such as India's contemplations on additional fighter jets). Safran leadership has publicly stated its readiness to set up a local engine assembly line and deep-localization framework in India if required by large-scale procurement volumes to meet stringent "Make in India" and local content mandates. 3. Broader Fighter Engine Roadmap Beyond the M88, Safran has positioned itself as a core partner for India's long-term military aviation goals. This includes parallel frameworks to cooperate with Indian agencies on future high-thrust propulsion tech (such as joint intellectual property and technology transfer pathways for India's advanced fighter programs).

In the last week of July, Ilaiyaraaja and Sanjay Subrahmanyan put out thirty devotional Tamil songs on Shiva. Ilaiyaraaja wrote them and the orchestration. Sanjay set them and sang them. Nobody had to call it a fusion or explain it. There was a time when the Carnatic establishment treated cinema as a threat, and film music borrowed classical respectability to be taken seriously at all. That has reversed. Ranjani and Gayatri say Ilaiyaraaja's phrases surface unconsciously in their concerts, and they have built a whole project around singing his songs with raga-tanam-pallavi treatment. Sanjay has sung for films. Cinema is also why most people know a raga at all. KV Mahadevan wrote songs where the raga set the emotional colour without announcing itself. Audiences absorbed Kalyani and Kapi through repetition, never through names. MS Subbulakshmi's voice reached homes that would never have bought a sabha ticket. Thunbam Nergayil was tuned in Raga Desh by Dandapani Desikar and then went largely unsung until a 1951 film picked it up. It is now standard on the concert circuit. And Ilaiyaraaja made film music sound modern by using more tradition, not less. Sankarabharanam, a 1980 Telugu film built entirely around an ageing classical vocalist, broke box-office records across the south. Remade in Hindi five years later, it went nowhere. Minister for Foreign Affairs Hon. Mr Shisir Khanal today officially launched the Nepal e-Attestation System (NEATS), developed by the Department of Consular Services. Addressing the launching ceremony, the Hon. Minister underscored the importance of digitalising consular services and expressed confidence that NEATS would make services easier, more accessible, transparent and predictable, while modernising service delivery in line with international best practices. Following the implementation of NEATS from 1 Bhadra 2083 (17 August 2026), applicants will be able to apply for consular attestation online, track their application status, make payments and book an appointment before visiting the Department. The system is expected to minimise processing delays and make the service more efficient, transparent and service-friendly.

France’s Safran has significantly expanded its footprint in India regarding the M88 engine (which powers the Dassault Rafale) through a mix of high-level industrial commitments, localized manufacturing collaborations, and specialized infrastructure: 1. The M88 MRO Facility in Hyderabad Safran established a dedicated Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) facility for the M88 engine in Hyderabad. This is Safran's first MRO facility for the M88 outside of France. It services the engines used by the Indian Air Force's Rafale fleet as well as the Indian Navy's Rafale-M variants, alongside potential regional export customers. Previously, these complex engine modules had to be flown back to France for heavy maintenance. 2. Local Production and Assembly Readiness While Safran and Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) have long-standing joint ventures (such as SAFHAL for helicopter engines like the Shakti) and cooperate heavily on civil LEAP engine components, discussions regarding the full local assembly and manufacturing of the M88 have scaled up alongside mega-defense procurement talks (such as India's contemplations on additional fighter jets). Safran leadership has publicly stated its readiness to set up a local engine assembly line and deep-localization framework in India if required by large-scale procurement volumes to meet stringent "Make in India" and local content mandates. 3. Broader Fighter Engine Roadmap Beyond the M88, Safran has positioned itself as a core partner for India's long-term military aviation goals. This includes parallel frameworks to cooperate with Indian agencies on future high-thrust propulsion tech (such as joint intellectual property and technology transfer pathways for India's advanced fighter programs).

काकोरी ट्रेन एक्शन की वर्षगांठ पर उन अमर क्रांतिकारियों को सादर नमन, जिन्होंने अपने साहस, त्याग और अदम्य राष्ट्रभक्ति से स्वतंत्रता संग्राम को नई दिशा और ऊर्जा प्रदान की। काकोरी की घटना केवल औपनिवेशिक शासन के विरुद्ध एक साहसिक कार्रवाई नहीं थी, बल्कि यह उस दौर के युवाओं के अटूट संकल्प और स्वतंत्र भारत के लिए सर्वस्व समर्पित करने की भावना का प्रतीक थी। चंद्रशेखर आज़ाद, राम प्रसाद बिस्मिल, अशफाकउल्ला खान और उनके साथियों का बलिदान हमें याद दिलाता है कि भारत की स्वतंत्रता असंख्य वीरों के त्याग और संघर्ष से अर्जित हुई है। आज उनकी स्मृति को नमन करते हुए, हमें स्वतंत्रता की इस अमूल्य विरासत को सहेजने और एक सशक्त, समृद्ध, आत्मनिर्भर एवं विकसित भारत के निर्माण के प्रति अपने संकल्प को और दृढ़ करना है।

‘भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन’ भारत के जनसंकल्प, जनशक्ति और स्वतंत्रता के अटूट विश्वास का एक अमर अध्याय है। 8 अगस्त 1942 को महात्मा गांधी जी के नेतृत्व में आरंभ हुए इस आंदोलन ने देशभर में नई चेतना का संचार किया और असंख्य भारतीयों को स्वतंत्रता के लिए एकजुट होकर संघर्ष करने की प्रेरणा दी। इस ऐतिहासिक दिवस पर राष्ट्रपिता महात्मा गांधी जी तथा देश की स्वतंत्रता के लिए अपना सर्वस्व अर्पित करने वाले सभी वीर स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों और शहीदों को सादर नमन। उनके त्याग, तप और संघर्ष से मिली स्वतंत्रता हमारी महान राष्ट्रीय विरासत है। आज उसी विरासत को आगे बढ़ाते हुए एक सशक्त, समृद्ध, आत्मनिर्भर और विकसित भारत के निर्माण के लिए निरंतर कार्य करना ही उनके प्रति सच्ची श्रद्धांजलि है।

The Pentagon is now giving defense contractors 21 days to come up with ways to dramatically accelerate weapons production as the Iran war continues to eat through U.S. stockpiles. Deputy Defense Secretary Steve Feinberg directed industry to propose faster delivery schedules, increased production and investments in new manufacturing capacity. The scale of the depletion is significant. The Pentagon says the U.S. has expended more than 850 Tomahawks, 1,000 Patriot/THAAD interceptors and 1,300 tactical ballistic missiles in the early stages of the war. A CSIS estimate cited by the Washington Post puts global Patriot inventories at under 827, down from roughly 2,200 before the war, while THAAD inventories have fallen from 452 to fewer than 278. The Pentagon has announced framework agreements to expand production, including the recent effort to triple PAC-3 production and quadruple production of key THAAD components. But these agreements still require congressional funding.

EL FINANCIAL TIMES DESTACÓ LA FINCA EN MENDOZA EN LA QUE CEOS DE EMPRESAS TECNOLÓGICAS PLANEAN ENFRENTAR UN POSIBLE “APOCALIPSIS” Empresarios argentinos y estadounidenses desarrollan un refugio autosuficiente en Mendoza, Argentina, destinado a enfrentar crisis globales como guerras nucleares, desastres climáticos o colapsos económicos. El proyecto, impulsado por el argentino Martín Varsavsky y otros cinco inversores, fue destacado este sábado por el prestigioso medio estadounidense Financial Times. Abarca una estancia de 32.000 hectáreas en las estribaciones de los Andes equipada con casas prefabricadas, domos geodésicos, pista de aterrizaje, energía solar y planes de producción ganadera, con el objetivo de asegurar autonomía en escenarios extremos. Wamani es una estancia de 32.000 hectáreas en las estribaciones de los Andes que Varsavsky compró en diciembre de 2023 junto con cinco coinversores para convertirla en un refugio autosuficiente. El plan incluye construcciones, paneles solares, una pista de aterrizaje, cría de ganado y el estudio de sistemas de inteligencia artificial desconectados de los servidores globales para operar en un escenario extremo. A una hora por caminos de tierra del pueblo más cercano, Wamani ocupa un terreno accidentado que Financial Times describe como cinco veces más grande que Manhattan. En los últimos dos años surgieron allí pequeñas casas prefabricadas, domos geodésicos y otras estructuras. Varsavsky definió el proyecto como una respuesta a un escenario geopolítico que considera ya en marcha. “Ya estamos en la Tercera Guerra Mundial, las líneas de batalla ya están trazadas”, dijo a Financial Times. El empresario sostuvo que “Tiene sentido tener un refugio” y planteó una idea más amplia que la de un simple búnker. “Mi idea no es sólo tener pequeños grupos encerrados en búnkers”, afirmó al periódico. Según Varsavsky, “toda Argentina y la región del Cono Sur” podrían sostener “sociedades complejas” después de una guerra nuclear. El empresario vinculó esa posibilidad con la distancia respecto de objetivos de misiles y nubes de radiación, además de la producción de alimentos y energía. Infobae 📎 infob.ae/4cuZe9c

🔴 Update #Iran Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, has outlined Tehran’s conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Read the latest demands on our live blog ⤵️ middleeasteye.net/live/live-…

The NYT reports that Iran has effectively rejected a deal on the Strait and presented a list of very hard-line demands in order for an agreement to be reached. My understanding of what has transpired differs somewhat. I see three possible interpretations, some of which overlap with the NYT's reporting. 1. There are divisions within the Iranian system in which hardline elements want to prolong the talks and have the current blockade inflict more damage on Trump and the global economy. Their narrative is that Iran agreed to the MOU too quickly, which contributed to the MOU's deterioration later. Tehran should have held out longer then, and it should also do so now, essentially. A variation of this explanation is what the USG is advancing: The lack of agreement is because of divisions in Iran. 2. Rather than a division, it may also be that a united system is seeking to prolong the talks to pressure the US. As such, a narrative of divisions in Iran may be seen as helpful, as it diverts from an arguably more problematic reality: The more flexible elements within the Iranian system also agree that talks should be prolonged. 3. The Iranian narrative, however, is that new elements were added to the talks at the last minute by the US and that Iran's on-the-surface hardened position is a reaction to what Tehran says is an attempt by the US to move the goalposts. Whether this is true or not, Tehran has tended to react in this manner (escalation) when it believes the US has shifted its position or added additional demands at the last minute. This is, however, not a denial of Zolghadr's list of demands. That list is an accurate reflection of Iran's broader goals, but ultimately, they won't be its demands for the immediate deal on the Strait. If the truth is closer to the third explanation, then a deal may still be within reach in the short term.

“DESALOJO EXPRÉS”: EN CUÁNTO TIEMPO SE PODRÁ PEDIR DESDE QUE EL INQUILINO DEJA DE PAGAR SI SE APRUEBA LA LEY DE PROPIEDAD PRIVADA El Senado avanzó con la media sanción del proyecto de ley de inviolabilidad de la propiedad privada, para cambiar las reglas que rigen las acciones de desalojo de inmuebles urbanos y rurales. Según el Gobierno, este “agiliza los procesos judiciales para recuperar inmuebles ocupados ilegalmente o frente a incumplimientos contractuales, fortaleciendo la protección del propietario sin dejar de resguardar a las personas en situación de vulnerabilidad”. La iniciativa, que todavía requiere la aprobación de la Cámara de Diputados para convertirse en ley, tiene como principales puntos lo siguientes: 1. Se agilizan los procesos de desalojo mediante el procedimiento sumarísimo. 2. Se habilita la restitución anticipada del inmueble cuando exista verosimilitud del derecho. 3. Se fortalecen las herramientas para desalojar ocupaciones ilegales. 4. Se simplifican las notificaciones y diligencias judiciales. 5. Se incorpora un procedimiento especial para casos de falta de pago y vencimiento de contrato. 6. Se mantiene la protección de menores, personas con discapacidad y adultos mayores mediante la intervención de los organismos competentes, sin paralizar el proceso judicial. Infobae 📎 infob.ae/4xxaaeP

We welcome the news of Judge Lourdes Afiuni’s full release and the closure of the baseless criminal case against her. After 16 years marked by arbitrary arrests, civil restrictions, and prolonged procedural delays, her freedom has finally been restored. Judge Afiuni became a symbol of the erosion of judicial independence and of the reprisals, pressure, and fear faced by judges and justice officials in politically motivated cases. While her long-awaited release is deeply welcome, her case remains a stark reminder: no judge or justice official should ever face political imprisonment, persecution, or retaliation for fulfilling their professional duties independently and in accordance with the law. PROVEA (@_Provea) La jueza María Lourdes Afiuni perdió 16 años de su vida por una condena sin base legal. Hoy finalmente cierran su caso, uno de los más documentados de persecución judicial en Venezuela. Afiuni fue detenida en 2009 tras otorgar medidas cautelares a Eligio Cedeño, víctima de detención arbitraria. La condenaron a 5 años por "corrupción propia" pese a que la fiscal del caso dejó constancia en el expediente de que no existió contraprestación alguna, requisito para que ese delito se configure según la ley venezolana. Fue encarcelada, denunció tortura física y psicológica. Su familia cuenta dieciséis años de control penal por una sentencia de cinco. Su persecución produjo lo que se conoce como el "efecto Afiuni": el miedo sistemático de jueces y funcionarios judiciales a decidir con independencia en casos con carga política. Su familia informó semanas atrás que le fueron detectadas tres lesiones tumorales que requieren atención médica inmediata, y que su única hija reside desde hace más de diez años en Estados Unidos. Pidieron que se eliminaran las restricciones derivadas del caso para que pudiera recibir tratamiento especializado y reunirse con ella. Con el expediente cerrado, ese acceso debe ser efectivo y sin trabas administrativas. El cierre no repara dieciséis años de persecución ni identifica a un solo responsable. Ningún juez en Venezuela debe volver a ser perseguido por aplicar la ley. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/_Provea/status/2085891867443368102#m

The modern battlefield has rediscovered positional warfare. Drones, sensors, and precision fires have compressed combat into a shallow, lethal “no-man’s-land.” Tactical gains rarely translate into operational or strategic decision. Maj. Gen. Thomas Feltey, Maj. Heath Rosendale, and Maj. David Webb diagnose the problem with precision in their *Military Review* piece: the failure is not primarily technological. It is a failure of operational art the connective tissue that links tactical actions across depth and time. Their framework **Break In, Break Through, Break Out** offers a coherent way to restore maneuver. It maps cleanly onto the modern sequence of forcible entry, penetration, and exploitation, and it places armor where it belongs: at the center of decision. - **Break In** is the contested entry. Infantry-centric combined-arms formations, enabled by engineers, joint fires, unmanned systems, and localized air superiority, seize and hold a lodgment. Specialized armor supports the breach and provides immediate protection and lethality at the point of contact. Without this foothold, nothing else is possible. - **Break Through** is the rupture. Here armored combined-arms formations become decisive. They concentrate mobility, protection, and firepower on a narrow front, drive 25–75 km deep, and expand the breach faster than the enemy can seal it. Infantry holds the shoulders and protects the flanks so the armor does not become isolated. Tempo is everything. Armored formations are built for sustained pressure under fire; they turn a penetration into a true rupture. - **Break Out** is the exploitation that converts rupture into collapse. Armored-centric formations pursue, disrupt, and destroy the enemy’s ability to reconstitute. Their protected mobility generates the continuous tempo required to keep the enemy disorganized. Airpower remains the operational connective tissue throughout, but without armored mass and endurance to exploit the opening, the door is kicked open with no one to go through it. History validates the sequence. Normandy’s lodgment, Operation Cobra’s penetration, and the subsequent exploitation across France; Inchon and the breakout from the Pusan Perimeter; the Israeli armored thrust through the Sinai in 1967. In each case, infantry secured access, armor ruptured and exploited, and joint airpower enabled the transitions. The same logic applies today. Ukraine illustrates the cost of incomplete execution. Forces can break in and even achieve local penetrations, yet lack the armored mass and sustainment to break through and break out. The result is meters of ground traded at enormous cost rather than decisions that collapse the enemy system. Drones and sensors are powerful enablers, but treated as stand-alone solutions they risk reinforcing the very stalemate they are meant to overcome. They extend the formation’s ability to see, strike, and protect; they do not replace the need for armored forces capable of operating at depth and tempo under persistent observation. The U.S. Army was designed to seize the initiative through offensive action. That requires more than better sensors or longer-range munitions. It requires formations organized, trained, and resourced to execute the full sequence infantry-centric forces for the break-in, armored combined-arms teams for the breakthrough, and armored-centric formations for the breakout synchronized by operational art and enabled by joint airpower. If we fail to reconnect tactics to strategy through this framework, we risk rediscovering the same costly lesson our predecessors learned at enormous price: a door kicked open is useless if no one is prepared to go through it. @SecWar @iiiarmoredcorps armyupress.army.mil/Journals…

Perhaps the greatest tragedy in the lead up to World War I was how the widespread expectation of a great European war paradoxically left the West genuinely stunned when one finally broke out. In less than 10 years, there were at least five instances where the Great Powers nearly came to blows. There was the First Moroccan Crisis in 1905-1906, the Bosnian Crisis in 1908-1909, the Second Moroccan Crisis in 1911, and finally two Balkan Wars from 1912–13. By July 1914, Europeans had become so accustomed to the fact that every few years, the newspapers would run front page headlines about an impending war, only for disaster to be averted at the 11th hour. This meant they had basically learned the wrong lesson that these things always get sorted out. So when things finally did explode, it caught tens of millions of people off guard. It’s like being told for 20 years that a major financial catastrophe is just around the corner and each time it’s put off until you think such a disaster will never actually happen, only for it to finally strike one day exactly as the last 20 years worth of predictions foretold.

Greetings to everyone on National Handloom Day. Instituted in 2015 under the visionary leadership of Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi, this day celebrates India's rich handloom heritage, the exceptional craftsmanship of our weavers, and the spirit of self-reliance. It also commemorates the launch of the Swadeshi Movement in 1905, which inspired the nation to embrace indigenous products and strengthen economic self-reliance. PM Modi has consistently championed India's handloom sector through the vision of "Vocal for Local." Through several transformative initiatives, our Government has been promoting handloom products, expanding market access, improving weavers' welfare, preserving traditional crafts, and encouraging every citizen to make locally made products an integral part of everyday life. Let us celebrate our weavers, preserve India's timeless weaving traditions, and reaffirm our commitment to Vocal for Local by proudly choosing handloom products.

“Rahhhh-ger CLARA Ship…the deck is moving.” Landing Signals Officers, aka “Paddles,” are the heartbeat of a Carrier Air Wing. Sometimes they give you an arguably undeserved bad grade (what do you mean that was a “full high” at the start…I had a rails pass all the way down!). And then they save your life. I met my first squadron off the coast of Japan in Feb 2008. I had a grand total of 22 Super Hornet traps under my belt and was thrust into the big leagues at the tender age of 26. Winter in the Sea of Japan is tough. The cold weather meant we needed to wear impermeable, full-body rubber suits under our flight gear, providing survival time if we had to eject into the frigid water. It also meant the seas were rough and the cloud cover was often low. A perfect mix for a young “nugget” pilot like myself to get himself into trouble when landing. To be blunt, I started as a below average ball flyer. My landing grades were bad. And then I got launched into a marginal weather day in pitching deck conditions. The flight itself was uneventful. But the 75 minutes of flight time was overshadowed by the inevitable need to land back on the ship in what we knew were going to be sporty conditions. The 5 minutes before landing was spent completely in the clouds. We only had one navigation aide available that day due to ships maintenance, so the air traffic controllers talked us down to a point where they handed us off to the LSOs. The controller ended with an abrupt “you’re at three quarters of a mile…on glide slope, on centerline, call the ball.” I couldn’t see the ship. Mustering as much confidence as I could in that terrifying moment, I abruptly pushed over the radio “CLARA ship.” CLARA means you can’t see something. “CLARA ship” means I couldn’t see the ship. And I was 15 seconds to landing, traveling 150 miles per hour, with a 700 foot per minute descent rate. Then the voice of CAG Paddles calmly slid into my ears: “Rahhhh-ger CLARA ship…the deck is moving. You’re a little high, easy with it.” This tested, 32 year old man, standing on the back of the ship, had my landing light in sight, and started smoothly talking me down. He also noted that the carrier deck was pitching up and down…implying he was gonna get me aboard safely. Those surreal moments passed with confident, directive, but calming words pouring into my headset that my hands and eyes instinctively responded to. The hundreds of practice passes learning that guidance made the real thing automatic. Suddenly, the ship appeared and a moment later we jerked to a stop. We had landed. “Nice work 107.” Thanks Paddles. For getting me aboard safely and saving my life. I never disputed a landing grade after that. Fly Navy. Video

El ministro de Hacienda entrante se la ha pasado insinuando que Colombia está algo “llevada”. Es evidente que están construyendo un relato con frases como: “Lo que recibo es malo, muy malo”, “Hubo una parranda de cuatro años y ahora viene el guayabo”, “El Estado es financieramente inviable”. Aunque evitan pronunciar la palabra quiebra, el mensaje que buscan posicionar es exactamente ese, y quiero ser claro, no estoy siendo ligero con el déficit. Para sostener esa tesis, apelan a The Economist, una publicación que evaluó 43 economías, sí solo cuarenta y tres, y en cuya muestra Colombia aparece de tercera con un déficit del 6,6%. Lo que omiten es que The Economist dejó por fuera a más de 150 naciones, incluyendo justamente a las que registran los mayores desbalances del planeta: economías en guerra, en colapso o microestados. Ahora bien, el Fondo Monetario Internacional publica dos veces al año el World Economic Outlook con cerca de 190 países, y en ese mapa global Colombia ni siquiera entra en el Top 10. Insistir en que el país podría estar en la ruina cumple tres objetivos políticos muy concretos, están trasladando toda la responsabilidad a la administración saliente, quieren reducir las expectativas ciudadanas frente a las promesas de campaña y le abre paso a recortes en el gasto social que tendrían un costo político insostenible. Mientras tanto, la economía real muestra otra cara, el desempleo bajó en junio, la pobreza continúa cayendo y el PIB acumula tres años en terreno positivo. El déficit fiscal existe y hay que gestionarlo con rigor, la verdadera discusión es sobre los hombros de quién va a caer el peso del ajuste del que tanto hablan y amenazan.

Iran's Supreme National Security Council has outlined six conditions it says must be met before the Strait of Hormuz will be reopened to commercial shipping: 1. Cease all threats and insults toward Iran. 2. Permanently end what Iran describes as its "war of aggression" against Iran and its allies in Lebanon, Palestine, Iraq, and Yemen. 3. Lift the naval blockade of Iran and withdraw all U.S. naval and air forces operating around the country. 4. Pay reparations for damage caused during the conflict. 5. Lift all sanctions imposed on Iran. 6. "Unconditionally" release all frozen Iranian assets. The demands underscore the significant gap that remains between the two sides. Several of the conditions, including ending the U.S. military presence in the region, lifting sanctions, and paying reparations, would represent major shifts in longstanding U.S. policy, making a near term resolution to the Strait of Hormuz crisis appear unlikely.

A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $576M and make changes to its Instagram and Facebook platforms to improve safety for young users and address harms that Meta’s social media platforms caused to their mental health. This fine accompanies a $375M fine that was ordered in March for misleading users over child safety. This is an action that we at Amnesty International have been calling for. Major social media platforms have been designed to maximize engagement and profit, while failing to adequately protect children's rights. Now, Meta will be required to change aspects of its platform design to better safeguard young users, while the funds from the settlement will support treatment services for young people in New Mexico.
